sources.name: Ukraine Common Operational Dataset administrative boundaries
sources.role: 2022 ADM0 land boundary used to retain detections inside internationally recognized Ukraine

methodology: Nominal- and high-confidence NOAA-20 VIIRS 375 m thermal detections are filtered to the OCHA Ukraine ADM0 land boundary. Standard Processing observations are used through their latest available date and Near Real-Time observations thereafter. Each point is classified against the latest available DeepState control snapshot on or before its acquisition date, plus the pre-2022 Crimea and Donbas footprint. Polygon members nested in historical GeoJSON GeometryCollection features are flattened before classification, non-Ukraine Transnistria context is excluded, and historical occupation polygons without normalized controlStatus metadata default to Russian-occupied, matching the map renderer.
limitation: A thermal anomaly is not proof of wildfire, combat damage, shelling, or cause. Industrial heat sources can be detected. Near-real-time observations can be revised, and a territory label can lag its acquisition date where control snapshots are sparse.
